mapper.insert: insert into xtrw(xtrwTitle, xtrwDesc, zfrUserId, zfrUserName, jzTime, createTime, updateTime, progress, status, isOverdue) values(#{xtrwTitle}, #{xtrwDesc}, #{zfrUserId}, #{zfrUserName}, #{jzTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{progress}, #{status}, #{isOverdue})
mapper.update: update xtrw set status=#{status}, summary=#{summary}, updateTime=NOW() where xtrwId=#{xtrwId}
update xtrw set progress=#{progress}, updateTime=NOW() where xtrwId=#{xtrwId}
mapper.insert: insert into xtrw_xtuser(xtrwId, xtUserId, xtUserName) values(#{xtrwId}, #{xtUserId}, #{xtUserName})
mapper.select: select * from xtrw_xtuser where xtrwId=#{xtrwId} and xtUserId=#{xtUserId}
mapper.insert: insert into xtrw_progress(xtrwId, userId, userName, progress, note, updateTime) values(#{xtrwId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{progress}, #{note}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from xtrw_progress where xtrwId=#{xtrwId} order by updateTime desc
mapper.insert: insert into xtrw_file(xtrwId, fileName, filePath, uploadTime, uploadUserId) values(#{xtrwId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{uploadTime}, #{uploadUserId})
insert into xtrw_visible_dept(xtrwId, departmentId, departmentName) values(#{xtrwId}, #{departmentId}, #{departmentName})
mapper.select: select * from xtrw where zfrUserId=#{zfrUserId} order by createTime desc
select x.* from xtrw x, xtrw_xtuser xt where x.xtrwId=xt.xtrwId and xt.xtUserId=#{xtUserId} order by x.createTime desc
select * from xtrw where status=0 and jzTime < NOW() order by jzTime asc
select * from xtrw where status=1 or status=2 order by updateTime desc
select x.* from xtrw x, xtrw_visible_dept vd where x.xtrwId=vd.xtrwId and vd.departmentId=#{departmentId} order by x.createTime desc
select * from xtrw where status=0 and isOverdue=0 and jzTime < NOW()
mapper.update: update xtrw set isOverdue=1 where xtrwId=#{xtrwId}
mapper.insert: insert into xtrw_todo(xtrwId, xtrwTitle, userId, createTime, isRead) values(#{xtrwId}, #{xtrwTitle}, #{userId}, #{createTime}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: select * from xtrw_todo where userId=#{userId} order by createTime desc
mapper.update: update xtrw_todo set isRead=#{isRead} where todoId=#{todoId}
update xtrw_todo set ggId=#{ggId} where todoId=#{todoId}
mapper.select: select * from xtrw_todo where xtrwId=#{xtrwId} limit 1
